zh: 入住酒店需要填一张登记表。
old_en: I had to fill out a form when checking into the hotel.
new_en: I need to fill out a form when checking into the hotel.

zh: 办理入住时，前台让我填一张表。
old_en: At check-in, the front desk asked me to fill in a form.
new_en: At check-in, the front desk asked me to fill out a form.

zh: 新员工入职要填一份申请表。
old_en: New employees have to fill out an application form when starting their job.
new_en: New employees have to fill out an application form when starting work.

zh: 我在申请信用卡，得填一份申请表格。
old_en: To apply for a credit card, I need to fill out an application form.
new_en: To apply for a credit card, I need to fill out an application form.

zh: 报销时需要填一张报销单。
old_en: When reimbursing expenses, I need to fill out a reimbursement form.
new_en: When claiming expenses, I need to fill out a reimbursement form.

zh: 出差回来要填报销表格。
old_en: After a business trip, I have to fill out the expense claim form.
new_en: After a business trip, I have to fill out an expense form.

zh: 这次调查只需要填一份简短问卷。
old_en: The survey only requires filling out a short questionnaire.
new_en: This survey only requires filling out a short questionnaire.

zh: 我在医院填了一张就诊单。
old_en: At the hospital, I filled out a registration form.
new_en: At the hospital, I filled out a registration form.

zh: 我填完入住表后交给前台。
old_en: I filled out the check-in form and handed it to the front desk.
new_en: I handed the completed check-in form to the front desk.

zh: 我在网上填了一份问卷。
old_en: I filled out a form online.
new_en: I filled out a questionnaire online.

zh: 退房时前台让我填一张表。
old_en: At check-out, the front desk made me fill out a form.
new_en: At checkout, the front desk asked me to fill out a form.

zh: 退房前我填好了结账单。
old_en: I filled out the checkout form before leaving the hotel.
new_en: I filled out the checkout form before leaving the hotel.

zh: 在超市结账时，我填了会员信息表。
old_en: At the checkout in the supermarket, I filled out the membership information form.
new_en: At the supermarket checkout, I filled out a membership information form.

zh: 结账时收银员让我填一张信息表。
old_en: The cashier asked me to fill out a form at the checkout.
new_en: The cashier asked me to fill out a form at checkout.

zh: 去医院看病时，我先填了一张表。
old_en: When I went to the hospital to see a doctor, I first filled out a form.
new_en: When I went to the hospital, I first filled out a form.

zh: 报名考试时，我填了一张个人信息表。
old_en: I filled out a form with my personal information when signing up for the exam.
new_en: When signing up for the exam, I filled out a personal information form.

zh: 新员工入职时，他填了一份入职申请表。
old_en: He filled out a form when starting his new job.
new_en: He filled out a new employee application when starting his job.

zh: 你填好退房表了吗？
old_en: Have you filled out the check-out form yet?
new_en: Have you finished filling out the check-out form?

zh: 申请表填好后，记得交给前台。
old_en: After you fill out the application, remember to hand it to the receptionist.
new_en: Remember to give the application to the front desk after you finish it.

zh: 这张入职表填起来很简单。
old_en: Filling out this employment form is very simple.
new_en: This employment form is very easy to fill out.
